name: 5-minute EMA9/21 cross in the day's direction (with VWAP and the open)
why: A short-term EMA cross only matters when the day's flow agrees — price above VWAP and the open means the session's buyers are in control and the cross is their continuation, not noise. Pre-registered 2026-10-16 (research/preregistered/2026-10-16_vwap_ema.md).

scan.when: (ema(5,9) > ema(5,21) && lag(5, ema(5,9) <= ema(5,21)) && px > vwap && px > open) || (ema(5,9) < ema(5,21) && lag(5, ema(5,9) >= ema(5,21)) && px < vwap && px < open)
scan.dir: (ema(5,9) > ema(5,21) && lag(5, ema(5,9) <= ema(5,21)) && px > vwap && px > open) - (ema(5,9) < ema(5,21) && lag(5, ema(5,9) >= ema(5,21)) && px < vwap && px < open)
